question: Can independently sourced lexical evidence support part of the frozen compact visual system's answer function?
reason: Unlike generic wrong-image sensitivity, this intervention selects whether an independent reading pathway deserves evaluation.
fixed_scope: All original 20 natural DEV, parent and candidate, old sealed noOCR anchors plus correct and length-matched wrong-source OCR; 80 new NLL and 80 generations; no training.
positive_action: Only review real lightweight OCR feasibility with complete weights and resource/error costs.
negative_action: Close this fixed source, input format and frozen-graph evidence channel; no prompt/donor/budget sweep.
limits: Report parent gain and student gain separately; shrinking the gap can include parent degradation.
Wrong-source text is not guaranteed semantically wrong and is not a real OCR error distribution.
Old candidate quality failure and unresolved medical/traffic losses remain.
Precomputed OCR does not prove actual OCR deployment cost or novelty.
